# What can you offer the seller and still get paid?

> Free calculator for real estate wholesalers: the most you can offer the seller, the end buyer's ceiling by the 70% rule and by profit, your fee by assignment versus double close, and how ARV errors move it. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
